'''Guila Angira''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[lieutenant]] in the [[Resistance]] [[Resistance navy|fleet]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. In [[34 ABY]], he served on the bridge of the [[MC85 Star Cruiser]] [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] under [[Captain]] [[Idrosen Gawat]] during the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation]] of the [[Resistance base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]] and [[Death|died]] when the First Order destroyed the bridge in an [[Battle of Oetchi|attack]] on the fleet after it exited [[hyperspace]] following the [[lightspeed]] jump from D'Qar.

==Biography==
===A successful escape===
Guila Angira<ref name="TLJVD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served in the [[Resistance]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. After the Resistance successfully [[Battle of Starkiller Base|destroyed]] the First Order's [[Starkiller Base]]<ref name="TLJ" /> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Angira was amongst the Resistance forces that [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuated]] from their [[Resistance base|base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]].<ref name="TLJ" /> During the evacuation, he held the rank of [[lieutenant]] and served as the [[gunnery officer]] on the bridge of the [[MC85 Star Cruiser]] [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] under the command of [[Captain]] [[Idrosen Gawat]].<ref name="TLJVD" />

As the Resistance [[transport]]ed its last personnel off D'Qar, the First Order [[First Order Navy|fleet]] arrived and attacked, but after the Resistance's forces successfully destroyed the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|First Order Dreadnought]]<ref name="TLJ" /> ''[[Fulminatrix]]'',<ref name="TLJVD" /> the ''Raddus'' successfully jumped to [[lightspeed]] with the rest of the Resistance forces and escaped.<ref name="TLJ" />

===Death===
Much to the surprise of the Resistance's commanders, the First Order managed to track them through lightspeed and quickly caught up with them after the ''Raddus'' and other vessels exited [[hyperspace]]. In the [[Battle of Oetchi|attack]] that followed, Angira was [[Death|killed]] along with most of the highest ranking members of the Resistance when the bridge of the ''Raddus'' was destroyed by missiles fired from two [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]]s. Those on the bridge who were not killed in the initial blast were sucked out into the vacuum of [[Realspace|space]], with only [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] managing to survive the ordeal.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Angira had dark skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and black [[hair]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Equipment==
While on the ''Raddus'', the lieutenant wore a brown, [[brimoss]]-fiber [[Clothing|uniform tunic]] with black pants, a brown belt, and a pair of brown service [[boot]]s.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Guila Angira was portrayed by [[Aki Omoshaybi]] in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
